name: Buharlı Lokomotif
scene: A vintage steam locomotive with three large driving wheels travels beneath a sweeping steam plume in an oval stained-glass panel.
notes: Target 84–124 panes. Warm locomotive against cool steam, sky and ground; cab windows show cool background. Final visual review: closed outlines and improved T junctions; residual subtle fill shading, narrow cab/chassis pieces and some same-colour neighbouring wheel/steam panes remain.
